messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person in the video with the person shown in the reference photo. Use the reference photo only to determine the target person's facial identity and skin tone. Apply that skin tone consistently to the face and body, while retaining the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person in the video with the person shown in the reference photo. Only use the reference photo to determine the target person's facial identity and skin tone. Apply that skin tone consistently to the face and body, while retaining the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The woman turns her head and body, initially facing away, then turning to face the camera while raising her hand to touch her hair.","camera":"Medium close-up, static camera at eye level.","clothing":"A bright pink, off-the-shoulder top with black trim and a black graphic on the chest.","hair_color":"Bright blonde.","hairstyle":"Blonde hair styled in a high bun with loose strands framing the face.","identity":"A 3D-rendered young woman with a slender build, fair skin, and prominent red eyeshadow and red lipstick.","scene":"A futuristic, neon-lit environment at night, featuring a large dome structure with glowing pink and blue lights in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output character's face and visible body skin became noticeably lighter/fairer than the source, while the blonde high-bun hairstyle, pink off-shoulder top, futuristic neon scene, camera framing, and head-turning action remained essentially the same.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's facial identity and skin tone with the reference person, applying the reference skin tone consistently to face and body while retaining hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.
uncertain: Whether the facial identity sufficiently matches the reference person, since the output face still appears stylized and the reference match is not clearly verifiable.
unexpected_changes: The output skin tone appears lighter than the reference photo's medium/tan skin tone.
